title: Global Attractors for Expanding Torus Symmetric Spacetimes
exact_target: Are the proposed late-time attractors global for both the special zero-conserved-quantity class and the remaining torus-symmetric solutions?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003921 (OWR-16411-014). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical General Relativity (2018), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2018/36, pp. 2157--2251. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 87.
Ringstrom T2 asymptotics (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Bellati--Reiris 2026 (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The metric ansatz, conserved quantity $B$ and admissible data are source-defined. All three tasks are retained: globality in $B_0$, existence of the non-$B_0$ attractor with both stated rates, and its globality in the full symmetry class.
